title: Bullion and Gifting Ecommerce Platform — Screen and Component Specification
notes: Each screen is decomposed as Screen → component/widget → fields or content → actions and validation. India-focused commerce for bullion, gems, rudraksh, gifts and Gold Vault.

children.title: Market research and MVP decision
Competitor patterns observed
MMTC-PAMP: direct bullion benchmark
Live prices and product-specific weights/purity
Search and filters for metal, product type, price and weight
Delivery estimate and PIN-code checks
Purity, certification, QR verification and brand credibility
Gifting-led coin and bar assortment
Tanishq: branded gifting benchmark
Gold and silver coins with weight and price filters
Occasion-led collections and recognizable brand trust
Product discovery by weight, karatage, metal and collection
Augmont: broader gold ecosystem benchmark
Physical coins and jewellery alongside digital gold/silver
Buyback and investment-adjacent services increase complexity
Research sources
MMTC-PAMP shop: https://www.mmtcpamp.com/shop
Tanishq gold coins: https://www.tanishq.co.in/shop/gold-coin
Augmont shop: https://augmont.com/shop

BIS hallmarking overview: https://www.bis.gov.in/hallmarking-overview/

Market implications
Compete on trust and execution, not catalogue breadth
Make purity, weight, price breakup, rate timestamp, delivery terms and returns easy to understand
Show authentic product photography and available certificates for each eligible SKU
Start with a curated range; do not build every category and automation before demand is proven
Initial customer hypotheses
Individual buyers seeking trusted gold or silver coins/bars for saving or gifting
Festival and occasion buyers who value packaging and delivery confidence
Corporate gifting buyers who need a credible catalogue, budget guidance and a quote
Proposed first assortment — hypothesis to validate
Small curated range of gold coins/bars across a few common weights
Small curated range of silver coins/bars and gifting-ready items
Rudraksh, coloured stones and gemstones: limited test collection only after supplier quality and certificate processes are clear
Corporate gifting: enquiry-led pilot with manual quote and fulfilment
MVP recommendation
Launch first: physical-product commerce
Catalogue, product detail, transparent price/tax breakup, stock, checkout, payment, invoice and insured tracked delivery
Live metal rate and a controlled price-lock/reprice process for bullion
Basic admin product, pricing, inventory, order, payment, refund, shipment and support operations
Customer contact, transactional messages, policies and consent records
Keep manual where possible
Corporate quotes and approvals
Product uploads and catalogue merchandising
Customer support, returns review and exception handling
Basic reports exported from orders and payments
Defer until demand is proven
Gold Vault digital buy/hold/sell
Loyalty, wallet, referrals, gift cards and advanced promotions
AI insights, recommendations and marketing automation
Full personalization production workflow and automated split delivery
Validation scorecard
Commercial signals
Qualified product-page visits and add-to-cart rate
Checkout completion and paid conversion
Average order value and product/category mix
Gross margin after payment, packaging, insurance, shipping and returns
Customer acquisition cost by channel and repeat purchase intent
Operational signals
Rate mismatch and price-lock expiry incidents
Payment failures, refunds and reconciliation exceptions
Dispatch SLA, delivery success and damage/loss rate
Support contacts per order and return/cancellation reasons
Decision gate
Expand only when contribution margin, fulfilment reliability and conversion are acceptable
Validate willingness to buy before investing in Gold Vault, broad catalogue automation or AI features
Priority colour legend
Green — MVP required
Needed to launch and safely test physical-product demand
Add in store pickup
Amber — validate next
Useful if customer behaviour or early operating load justifies it
Grey — later phase
Defer until product-market evidence or compliance readiness supports it
Website screens
Homepage
Header and navigation
Logo and primary navigation: Bullion, Gold Coins/Bars, Silver Coins/Bars, Gems and Coloured Stones, Rudraksh, Gifts, Corporate Gifting, Gold Vault
Search: keyword input, autocomplete suggestions, recent searches
Customer controls: login/profile, wishlist, cart count, language, support
Rules: show only published categories; cart count reflects active cart
Hero banner
Content: headline, supporting copy, desktop/mobile image, CTA label, CTA destination, schedule, active status
Actions: shop now, explore collection, request corporate quote
Rules: hide expired banners; validate CTA destination
Category tiles
Content: category name, image/icon, destination URL, display order, active status
Categories: gold coins/bars, silver coins/bars, gems/stones, rudraksh, gifts, corporate gifting
Actions: open category listing
Live metal-rate strip
Fields: gold rate, silver rate, reference market/city, purity/unit, currency, last refreshed timestamp, feed status
Actions: view rate details, browse bullion
Rules: show timestamp; flag stale feed; never present stale rates as live
Featured and bestseller products
Product card fields: image, name, SKU, current price, purity/weight where relevant, offer badge, stock status, rating, wishlist control
Actions: quick view, product detail, wishlist, add to cart when eligible
Rules: active in-stock SKUs only unless backorder is explicitly enabled
Festival and curated collections
Fields: collection name, occasion, banner, mapped SKUs, start/end dates, display order
Actions: explore collection, shop products
Rules: hide expired collections and unavailable products
Offers carousel
Fields: offer title, coupon, eligibility summary, start/end date, terms link
Actions: view offer, copy/apply coupon
Rules: show active offers only; clearly disclose exclusions
Corporate gifting entry
Content: corporate value proposition, curated kits, quantity/budget prompts, branding and split-delivery benefits
Fields: CTA, minimum quantity if configured, enquiry destination
Actions: request a quote, explore gift kits
Gold Vault entry
Content: digital buy/hold/sell explanation, live buy/sell rates, spread and partner disclosure link
Actions: view Gold Vault, sign in or complete required checks
Rules: do not imply guaranteed returns; show applicable risk disclosures
Trust and education
Content: purity and hallmark explanation, HUID/certificates, secure insured shipping, invoice and support links
Fields: trust badge, explanatory copy, destination URL, evidence/source reference
Rules: claims must match product and compliance records
Recommendations and recently viewed
Fields: customer segment, viewed/purchased SKU IDs, recommendation reason, priority, fallback products
Actions: revisit product, wishlist, add to cart
Rules: use consented data; fallback to bestsellers without history
Testimonials and footer
Testimonial fields: quote, customer display name/permission, product, approval status
Footer content: contact, policies, FAQs, shipping/returns, privacy, terms, social links, newsletter consent
Rules: only approved testimonials; record marketing consent separately
Product listing and search
Search and result summary
Fields: keyword, autocomplete, result count, category, no-results state
Actions: search, clear query, browse suggested categories
Filter panel
Fields: price range, metal, purity, weight, stone type, rudraksh mukhi, origin, occasion, availability, rating, personalization, offer, delivery PIN code
Actions: apply, clear, remove individual filter
Rules: filters return active/visible products; bullion prices use latest valid calculated price
Sort and product grid
Sort: relevance, price low/high, newest, popularity, rating
Card fields: image, name, SKU, price, old price if valid, discount badge, purity, weight, availability, rating
Actions: detail, quick view, wishlist, compare, add to cart where allowed
Delivery checker
Fields: PIN code, serviceability result, estimated delivery date, shipping restriction
Rules: use current serviceability response; do not promise an unsupported ETA
Product detail page
Media gallery
Fields: image set, video where available, alt text, sequence, zoom
Actions: view image/video, zoom
Product identity and specifications
Fields: product name, SKU, category, description, dimensions, weight/unit, metal, purity/fineness, stone type/origin, rudraksh mukhi, care instructions
Rules: show category-specific attributes only
Price and price breakup
Fields: current price, live metal rate, purity conversion, weight, markup/premium, making charge, packaging/insurance where applicable, GST, total, last refresh time
Actions: view breakup, refresh rate
Rules: price must match pricing engine; show timestamp and applicable taxes/charges
Authenticity and certificates
Fields: hallmark status, HUID, BIS reference where applicable, certificate type/number, issuer/assaying centre, certificate image/PDF
Actions: view/download certificate
Rules: show only verified and applicable claims
Availability and delivery
Fields: stock status, quantity, PIN code, serviceability, ETA, shipping/insurance message
Actions: check PIN, select quantity
Personalization widget
Fields: eligibility, engraving text, recipient name, gift message, occasion, packaging, personalization charge, lead time, preview
Rules: enforce character/language limits and show changed cancellation/return rules
Offers, reviews and related items
Fields: eligible offers, coupon terms, rating, review text/media, FAQs, related SKU list
Actions: apply offer, ask question, share, wishlist, compare
Purchase actions
Actions: add to cart, buy now
Rules: disable purchase when unavailable; validate quantity, price and eligibility
Live pricing and price lock
Rate display
Fields: metal, purity, rate/unit, reference market, source, timestamp, stale status
Checkout lock
Fields: locked rate, locked price, lock start/end, countdown, order/cart reference
Actions: lock price, refresh/recalculate, continue payment
Rules: expired lock forces repricing and renewed customer confirmation
Login, registration and profile
Registration and login
Fields: mobile/email, OTP, full name, password where applicable, consent preferences
Actions: request OTP, verify, resend, login, logout
Rules: validate contact; rate-limit OTP; record consent and security events
Profile and address book
Fields: name, mobile, email, date of birth, anniversary, billing/shipping addresses, PIN, GSTIN, PAN/KYC status, preferences
Actions: edit profile, add/edit address, verify sensitive changes
Rules: validate supplied tax IDs; protect sensitive fields
Account history
Components: orders, invoices, certificates, wishlist, saved items, loyalty, wallet, referrals, Gold Vault holdings, support tickets
Fields: order/transaction IDs, status, date, amount, document links, reward balances
Rules: documents and records must belong to authenticated customer
Cart and saved items
Cart line items
Fields: SKU, product, variant, quantity, current/locked price, personalization, stock status
Actions: change quantity, remove, save for later
Cost summary
Fields: subtotal, discount, coupon, GST, shipping, insurance, packaging, total payable
Actions: apply/remove coupon, view terms, proceed to checkout
Rules: refresh bullion pricing unless a valid lock exists; enforce stock and offer eligibility
Checkout — physical products
Customer and address
Fields: login/guest status, contact, billing/shipping address, PIN, GSTIN, delivery instructions
Actions: select/add address, validate serviceability
Order review and compliance
Fields: products, quantities, locked rate/timer, tax breakup, coupon, gift message, PAN/KYC trigger, terms acceptance
Actions: confirm order details, accept applicable terms
Rules: complete address and serviceability required before payment
Payment selection
Fields: gateway, UPI, cards, net banking, wallet, EMI/BNPL if enabled,  payable amount
Actions: pay, retry failed payment
Rules: expired price lock blocks payment; confirm through gateway webhook
Payment, invoice and confirmation
Payment status
Fields: transaction ID, gateway reference, status, amount, timestamp, retry link
Rules: idempotent webhook processing; order confirmed only after verified success or approved offline payment
Invoice and receipt
Fields: invoice number, order ID, customer/GSTIN, addresses, product/HSN, taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST, total, payment reference, PDF reference, email status, IRN/QR where applicable
Actions: download invoice, resend email
Rules: immutable PDF; correct via credit/debit note; retry failed email/storage
Confirmation page
Fields: order ID, payment status, delivery address, order summary, invoice status, next steps
Actions: view order, track order, continue shopping
Shipping, tracking and delivery
Tracking page
Fields: courier, tracking ID, shipment status, ETA, insured status, package value, recipient/address summary, proof of delivery
Actions: track shipment, contact support
Rules: restrict sensitive logistics details; lock address edits after dispatch
Delivery exceptions
Fields: failure reason, latest event, support ticket, next action, revised ETA
Actions: raise issue, reschedule where supported
Corporate gifting website journey
Corporate landing and enquiry form
Fields: company, contact person, mobile/email, GSTIN if available, occasion, quantity, budget per recipient, product preferences, branding, delivery schedule, recipient count, remarks, lead source
Actions: submit enquiry, upload logo/brief
Rules: company/contact, quantity and budget required; validate file type/size; send acknowledgement
Quote review and approval
Fields: quote ID, curated products, unit price, customization, shipping, taxes, total, margin-approved status, expiry, payment terms
Actions: accept quote, request revision, approve branding proof
Recipient and delivery details
Fields: recipient name, phone/email where needed, address/PIN, gift variant/message, delivery date, shipment grouping
Rules: validate addresses; support split delivery and privacy controls
Personalization order journey
Personalization setup
Fields: eligible SKU, engraving text, recipient, message, language, symbols, packaging, preview, charge, production lead time
Actions: preview, confirm customization
Production and delivery status
Fields: production stage, artwork approval, quality check, packaging, dispatch and tracking
Rules: disclose non-returnable/restricted cancellation terms before payment
Loyalty, referrals and offers
Rewards dashboard
Fields: tier, points balance, expiry, wallet credits, gift-card balance, eligible offers, exclusions
Actions: redeem, view history
Referral
Fields: referral code/link, referee status, qualifying order, reward status
Rules: issue rewards only after qualifying event
Gift cards
Fields: code, balance, expiry, eligible categories, redemption minimum
Rules: expired/ineligible cards cannot be redeemed
Support, returns and cancellation
Support request form
Fields: ticket ID, order ID, issue type, message, attachments, contact channel
Actions: submit, add evidence, view status
Eligibility and resolution
Fields: return/cancellation window, product type, reason, approval, pickup, refund/replacement, SLA, resolution notes
Rules: bullion/customized/corporate policies vary; verify order ownership; refund tied to payment
Help and policy content
Fields: policy version, FAQ, expected resolution time, escalation contact
Content, SEO and education
Content page template
Fields: title, slug, meta title, meta description, body, FAQ, related products, images, publish status
Content types: buying guides, purity, hallmarking, gemstone certificates, rudraksh guidance, gifting guides, FAQs, policies, blogs, festival collections
Rules: unique URLs; claims match backend; version policy pages
Gold Vault customer journey — MVP
Vault overview
Fields: account ID, gold balance in grams, indicative holding value, buy rate, sell rate, spread, rate timestamps, partner/custody disclosure
Actions: buy, sell, view transactions and statements
Buy gold
Fields: amount, estimated grams, buy rate, GST, spread, payment method, KYC status, terms acknowledgement
Actions: confirm purchase, pay
Rules: failed payment must not credit gold; show all charges before confirmation
Sell gold
Fields: grams/amount, sell rate, estimated proceeds, verified payout account, settlement status
Actions: confirm sell, track payout
Rules: verified payout instrument; failed settlement traceable and reversible
Holdings and documents
Fields: transaction ledger, transaction certificate, downloadable holding statement, purity, backing/custody disclosure, audit status
Rules: show spread and GST impact; no guaranteed-return claims
MVP boundary
Digital buy, hold and sell only; physical or jewellery redemption is Phase 2 and must not be marketed before operational/legal approval
Admin screens
Admin login and password recovery
Login form
Fields: username/email, password, remember device, risk-triggered CAPTCHA, MFA OTP
Actions: login, show/hide password, forgot password, resend OTP, contact administrator
Rules: rate-limit attempts; restrict inactive users; record login/security events
Password reset
Fields: registered email/mobile, OTP/reset link, new password, confirmation
Rules: token expiry, password strength/history and match; revoke sessions after reset
Security events
Events: successful/failed login, suspicious device, password reset/change, MFA challenge, lockout, timeout
Communications: reset link/OTP and suspicious-login alert
Admin dashboard
Global filters and controls
Fields: date range, warehouse, category, sales channel, payment status, order status, customer segment, campaign, corporate account, Gold Vault transaction type
Actions: refresh, export, drill down, assign exception, approve task, view audit trail
Rules: date range required; role-based visibility; show data-sync warnings
Revenue and margin widgets
Metrics: total revenue, bullion revenue, non-bullion revenue, gross margin, average order value, period comparison
Includes: date range, currency, source status, drill-down to orders and reports
Orders widget
Metrics: orders today, total orders, pending confirmation, cancelled orders, order status counts
Includes: status, date, product type, owner, link to filtered order list
Payments and refunds widget
Metrics: failed payments, payment mismatch, pending refunds, refund status
Includes: gateway, transaction reference, amount, age, exception link
Live metal rates widget
Metrics: gold rate, silver rate, rate movement, last refresh, provider status
Actions: open pricing screen, inspect rate log
Rules: stale-rate alert; abnormal movement alert
Inventory widget
Metrics: inventory value, low-stock SKUs, reserved stock, damaged stock, stockout risk
Includes: SKU, warehouse, available/reserved quantity, reorder level
Marketing widget
Metrics: abandoned carts, active campaigns, offer use, conversion and attributed revenue
Includes: campaign, segment, channel, spend/cost if integrated, conversions
Corporate gifting widget
Metrics: new enquiries, quotes awaiting approval, active bulk orders, dispatch exceptions
Includes: company, quote value, quantity, stage, owner, next action
Gold Vault widget
Metrics: buy/sell volume, customer gold balance, pending/failed settlements, partner balance, backing certificate value, reconciliation status
Includes: rate feed status, exception count, link to reconciliation queue
Support and approval widgets
Metrics: open tickets, SLA breaches, pending approvals, high-value refunds, pricing overrides
Includes: priority, age, assigned owner, approval limit, escalation action
AI insights and system health
Metrics: recommendations, forecast risks, fraud/anomaly alerts, integration outages
Includes: confidence, explanation, affected SKU/order/customer, suggested action, human approval state
Dashboard data integrity
Rules: figures reconcile to order/payment state; unauthorized widgets hidden; negative values require valid return/refund context
Admin navigation and settings
Main navigation

Modules: Dashboard, Catalog, Pricing, Inventory, Orders, Payments/Refunds, Fulfillment, Gold Vault, CRM, Corporate Gifting, Offers, Recommendations, Marketing, Loyalty/Wallet, Compliance, Invoices/Tax, Reports, AI Insights, Support, Integrations, Roles, Audit Logs, Settings
Settings screens
Fields: store settings, tax settings, payment settings, shipping settings, communication templates, approval workflows, password policy, API keys, data retention, legal policies
Rules: restrict configuration by role; audit sensitive changes
Product catalog administration
Product list
Fields: SKU, product name, category, metal, purity, weight, stock, calculated MRP, status, visibility, approval state, updated date
Actions: search, filter, add, edit, duplicate, archive, bulk select
Product editor — core details
Fields: name, product type, category/subcategory, SKU, unit, dimensions, origin, stone type, rudraksh mukhi, tags, descriptions
Product editor — pricing and tax
Fields: HSN, GST rate, live-rate flag, metal, purity, weight, markup percentage, premium/making percentage, fixed charges, calculated MRP
Rules: unique SKU; bullion requires metal/purity/weight/rule; positive weight; tax and price logic required
Product editor — compliance and media
Fields: images, video, certificate upload, hallmark/HUID, certificate status, SEO title/description, visibility, featured flag
Rules: active product requires image and valid selling-price logic; certified item requires certificate as configured
Product approval and publishing
Flow: draft → validate → preview → submit approval → approve/reject → publish
Fields: submitter, reviewer, reason, approval status, timestamp, before/after values
Bulk upload and update
Fields: batch ID, CSV/XLSX file, selected SKUs/category, update type, validation errors, impact preview, approver, publish status
Flow: select → upload/edit → validate → preview → approve → publish → audit
Rules: preserve before/after history; high-value price changes require approval
Live rates and pricing administration
Provider setup and rate monitor
Fields: provider, metal, purity, base rate, reference market/city, unit conversion, refresh interval, last refresh, provider health, fallback source
Actions: test connection, refresh, switch fallback, inspect logs
Pricing rules
Fields: category/product markup percentage, premium type/value, making charge, packaging, insurance, GST, effective dates
Rules: formula and tax base must be confirmed with finance; preview before publish
Price lock configuration
Fields: duration, lock start/end, eligible products, expiry behaviour
Rules: duration greater than zero; expired lock requires recalculation
Manual override and bulk publish
Fields: override flag, reason, requested value, approver, batch ID, affected SKU count, before/after price
Actions: simulate, submit approval, publish, roll back where supported
Rules: reason and approver mandatory; audit every change
Rate audit and alerts
Fields: timestamp, source, old/new rate, movement percentage, stale status, alert status, resolution
Events: feed failure, stale rate, abnormal movement, failed bulk publish
Inventory and stock control
Inventory overview
Fields: SKU, warehouse, available, reserved, sold, damaged, reorder level, procurement cost, status
Actions: receive, transfer, reserve, release, adjust, mark damaged
Serialized and batch inventory
Fields: batch number, serial number, HUID/certificate number, unit identifier, location
Rules: unique serial per unit; no negative stock; reserved stock expires with cart/payment timeout
Stock adjustment approval
Fields: reason, quantity delta, evidence, requester, approver, audit record
Rules: high-value adjustments require maker-checker
Orders administration
Order list and queues
Queues: all, pending confirmation, payment failed, customized, high-value, cancellation/return, refund queue, exceptions
Fields: order ID, customer, amount, product type, payment, invoice, fulfillment, delivery, risk flag, date, owner
Order detail
Fields: customer profile, line items, locked rate/expiry, price breakup, payment reference, billing/shipping address, PAN/KYC flag, personalization, courier, tracking, notes
Actions: verify, assign, hold, cancel where eligible, refund request, open shipment
Order processing workflow
Steps: verify payment → generate invoice → reserve stock → pick/pack checklist → allocate courier/insurance → dispatch → track → deliver → close
Rules: stop on payment mismatch, expired lock, missing KYC, invoice/PDF failure, stock failure or insurance mismatch
Payments, refunds and reconciliation
Payment transactions
Fields: transaction ID, order ID, gateway, method, amount, status, webhook status, settlement reference, timestamps
Actions: inspect, retry supported operation, reconcile
Refund queue
Fields: order/payment ID, paid amount, requested refund, reason, eligibility, approver, gateway status, settlement status
Rules: refund cannot exceed paid amount; high-value refunds require maker-checker
Financial reconciliation
Includes: gateway transactions, orders, invoices, refunds, settlements, Gold Vault entries
Fields: expected amount, actual amount, variance, status, owner, resolution note
Fulfillment and shipping administration
Shipping rules
Fields: serviceable PIN code, courier, method, declared value, insurance required, packaging, pickup location, COD eligibility
Actions: configure, test serviceability, assign courier
Shipment operations
Fields: order ID, courier, tracking ID, ETA, shipment status, package value, insurance status, proof of delivery, failure reason
Actions: print checklist, dispatch, track, resolve exception
Rules: high-value bullion insured; declared value matches invoice; COD disabled unless approved
Corporate split delivery
Fields: recipient list, delivery address/PIN, package allocation, dispatch group, tracking, delivery outcome
Rules: validate recipient addresses before dispatch
Compliance and certificates administration
Compliance record
Fields: BIS registration reference, hallmark status, HUID, purity grade, assaying centre, certificate number/file, GSTIN, PAN/KYC flag, notes
Actions: upload, verify, approve, renew/expire, publish customer copy
Rules: authorized roles only; require applicable hallmark/HUID and certificates
Compliance review queue
Fields: record/SKU, missing data, risk level, reviewer, decision, timestamp, audit history
Invoice and tax document administration
Invoice generation
Fields: invoice number, order, customer/GSTIN, addresses, HSN, taxable value, tax rates/amounts, discount, shipping, insurance, total, payment reference
Actions: generate PDF, store copy, email, retry, download
Rules: after verified payment/approved offline payment; totals reconcile to paid amount
Credit/debit notes and e-invoice
Fields: original invoice, adjustment reason, taxable adjustment, tax adjustment, IRN/QR where applicable, status
Rules: invoice immutable; corrections through credit/debit note; e-invoice only where legally applicable
Customer CRM and support administration
Customer list and profile
Fields: customer ID, name, mobile/email, addresses, GSTIN/PAN, KYC, orders, lifetime value, preferences, loyalty, referrals, Gold Vault balance, consent, tickets, risk flags
Actions: search, review duplicate, view timeline, segment, update permitted fields
Rules: validate contacts/IDs; flag duplicates; mask sensitive data by role
Customer consent and segmentation
Fields: channel consent, purpose, timestamp, source, segment criteria, membership status
Rules: marketing only to opted-in customers; honour opt-out
Support ticket queue
Fields: ticket ID, order ID, issue, priority, SLA, assignee, message, attachments, resolution, refund/replacement action, status
Actions: assign, request evidence, resolve, escalate, close
Rules: verify identity/order ownership; flag SLA breach
Corporate gifting administration
Enquiry and qualification
Fields: company, contact, source, occasion, budget, quantity, product preferences, timeline, owner, lead stage
Actions: qualify, assign, schedule consultation
Quote builder
Fields: quote ID, products/kits, quantities, unit prices, customization, packaging, shipping, tax, total, margin, expiry, payment terms
Actions: generate, revise, submit approval, send quote
Rules: margin threshold and credit terms require approval
Branding and personalization approval
Fields: logo file, artwork proof, engraving text, packaging option, approver, revision, approval status
Actions: preview, approve, request revision
Recipient import and dispatch
Fields: recipient file, name, contact, address/PIN, item, gift message, shipment group, delivery date
Actions: upload, validate, split shipments, track
Rules: validate format and addresses; preserve recipient privacy
Campaign completion report
Fields: corporate account, campaign/occasion, quantity ordered/delivered, on-time delivery, exceptions, spend, quote value, ROI inputs, renewal date
Personalization production administration
Production queue
Fields: order/SKU, engraving text, recipient, packaging, artwork proof, stage, due date, lead time, QA status, exception
Actions: approve proof, start production, QA, pack, dispatch
Rules: QA failure blocks dispatch; track delay and packaging shortage
Offers and promotion administration
Offer builder
Fields: name, type, discount type/value, minimum order, category/SKU, segment, coupon, usage limit, dates, combinability, approval status
Actions: create, preview, approve, schedule, pause, report
Rules: unique code; valid dates; margin guardrails for bullion; enforce per-customer usage
Offer performance
Fields: impressions, redemptions, orders, revenue, discount cost, margin impact, segment, channel
Subtopic 3
Recommendation and personalization rules administration
Rule builder
Fields: rule name/type, trigger, segment, category/SKU, occasion, price range, metal preference, gift intent, behaviour, purchase-history flag, exclusions, priority, dates, status
Actions: create, test, preview, publish, measure
Rules: trigger and output required; excluded SKUs suppressed; respect consent; hide out-of-stock products unless backorder enabled
Marketing automation and communications
Campaign builder
Fields: campaign name/goal, channel, trigger, audience, message template/version, product/offer mapping, language, send time, frequency cap, consent, status
Flow: choose goal → segment → template/offer → channel → preview → approval → schedule/launch → performance
Event-triggered journeys
Events: OTP, registration, payment, invoice, order/shipping, support, abandoned cart, back-in-stock, birthday/anniversary, festival, loyalty, referral, win-back
Fields: event, trigger criteria, delay, channel priority, fallback, retry, suppression rules
Delivery and performance logs
Fields: sent/delivered/failed, open/click/conversion, attributed revenue, failure reason, retry count
Rules: marketing consent and opt-out; frequency caps; exclude completed carts; log template version and delivery
Loyalty, referral, wallet and gift-card administration
Loyalty rules
Fields: tier, earning rule, redemption value, expiry, eligible categories, excluded SKUs, approval status
Wallet and gift cards
Fields: wallet balance, ledger entry, reason, gift-card code, balance, expiry, minimum redemption, status
Rules: audit every credit/debit; expire rewards automatically; restrict excluded SKUs
Referral rules
Fields: referral code, referrer/referee reward, qualifying event, reward status, fraud flag
Gold Vault administration
Vault dashboard
Widgets: customer gold balance, buy/sell volume, pending/failed settlements, partner balance, backing certificate value, rate-feed status, reconciliation status, exception count
Buy/sell transaction detail
Fields: transaction ID, customer, type, grams, rate/time, GST, spread, payment reference, partner reference, ledger status, certificate, invoice, settlement
Customer and partner ledgers
Fields: customer account, opening/closing grams, movements, partner balance, backing certificate, custody location, purity, audit status
Daily reconciliation
Compare: customer balances, vault partner ledger, payments/refunds, sell settlements, invoices, certificates
Fields: expected/actual, variance, exception reason, owner, resolution, checker approval
Rules: 100% physical backing; shortfall alerts; corrections require maker-checker
Vault disclosures and controls
Fields: terms version, buy/sell spread, GST disclosure, custody/insurance, partner, risk acknowledgement, KYC status, limits, payout bank verification
Rules: legal/tax/payments counsel sign-off; no guaranteed-return language; Phase 2 redemption not enabled in MVP
AI insights and automation
Insight feed
Fields: insight type, confidence, explanation, affected SKU/customer/order, forecast period, anomaly reason, suggested action, inventory/fraud risk
Review and execution
Actions: inspect, accept/reject, request approval, execute, record feedback
Fields: decision, override reason, approver, feedback, audit timestamp
Rules: human approval for pricing, refunds, stock changes and customer communications; log accepted and rejected outputs
Reports, analytics and audit
Report builder
Fields: report name/type, date range, filters, export format, generated by/time
Reports: sales/margin, orders/payments/refunds, inventory, rate history, compliance, customer, campaign ROI, corporate gifting, Gold Vault reconciliation
Actions: generate, preview, export, save/schedule
Rules: date range required; role-based access; mask sensitive data; audit exports
Audit log viewer
Fields: actor, action, entity, before/after values, timestamp, reason, approver, source/IP where permitted
Rules: logs are immutable and access-controlled
Roles, permissions and approvals
Role editor
Fields: role name, modules, view/create/edit/delete/approve rights, approval limit, status
Admin user management
Fields: name, email, mobile, role, status, last login, MFA, activity log

End-to-end workflows
Physical product purchase

Browse → listing → product detail → PIN check → personalize if eligible → cart → bullion price lock → checkout/KYC → payment → order confirmation → invoice PDF/email → stock allocation → pick/pack/insurance → dispatch → tracking → delivery → review/support
Exceptions: failed payment, expired lock, stock conflict, KYC hold, invoice failure, courier/insurance failure, failed delivery
Corporate gifting order

Enquiry → qualify budget/quantity/occasion → curate products → quote and margin approval → branding proof → recipient upload/validation → payment terms → bulk order/invoice → production/QA → split dispatch → delivery report → campaign ROI and renewal
Personalization order
Eligibility → enter text/message → preview → accept production/return terms → pay → production queue → artwork/engraving check → QA → gift packing → dispatch → recipient updates
Gold Vault buy/hold/sell
Disclosures → KYC if required → view separate buy/sell rates → confirm amount and charges → payment → credit grams → certificate/statement
Sell flow: select grams → confirm sell rate/proceeds → verified payout account → settlement → reconcile ledgers
Daily reconciliation: customer balances ↔ vault ledger ↔ payments/refunds ↔ sell settlements ↔ invoices/certificates
Returns and support
Ticket → verify customer/order/payment → evaluate product-specific policy → approve/reject → pickup/replacement/refund → credit/debit note if needed → notify customer → close and capture feedback
Integrations and governance
Shared data and pricing rules
Product master: unique SKU, attributes, HSN/GST, weight/purity, media, SEO, certificates and visibility
Pricing ledger: source/timestamp, purity conversion, markup/premium, charges, GST, lock, overrides and approvals
Order ledger: order, payment webhook, locked price, stock reservation, invoice, shipment, refund and messages linked by IDs
Communication event framework
Channels: email, SMS, WhatsApp, push and in-app
Template fields: event, template/version, language, tokens, consent, priority/fallback, retry, delivery status and failure reason
Transactional events: OTP, account, payment, invoice, order, shipment, support, return and refund
Marketing events: cart recovery, price alert, festival, birthday/anniversary, loyalty and win-back
Rules: consent/opt-out for marketing; log timestamp, channel, template version, retries and delivery
Legal and release gates
Gold Vault positioning: gold purchase/holding service; no guaranteed return, deposit, ETF, SGB or derivative claims
Disclosures: separate buy/sell rates, spread, GST, custody, vault partner, purity, insurance, risks, settlement, complaints and redemption policy
KYC/AML, limits, suspicious activity and bank verification must follow legal/payment-partner advice
Confirm Indian GST/tax treatment and legal wording with qualified counsel before launch
Require 100% physical backing, independent audit, insurance, custody evidence and daily reconciliation before Gold Vault activation
MVP Gold Vault: digital buy/hold/sell only; physical/jewellery redemption is Phase 2

Release tests: pricing/stale feed/lock expiry; catalog/certificates/tax; payment webhook/refund reconciliation; shipping/insurance/split delivery; invoice archive/email retry; consent/frequency caps; Gold Vault KYC/backing/reconciliation
